title: Create chatbot/voice/__init__.py and base provider interface
description:
Create the chatbot/voice/ package with an abstract provider interface that mirrors the LLM Provider pattern from chatbot/providers/. Define TTSProvider and STTProvider abstract base classes with exact-identifier validation (provider_id, model_id) matching the existing provider discipline.

The package init must export the base classes. The base module must define:
- A `VoiceSynthesisRequest` dataclass with text (str), voice_params (dict[str, Any]), and format (str, default 'mp3').
- A `VoiceSynthesisResult` dataclass with audio_data (bytes), content_type (str), duration_ms (float), and format (str).
- A `VoiceTranscriptionRequest` dataclass with audio_data (bytes), audio_format (str), and language (str | None).
- A `VoiceTranscriptionResult` dataclass with text (str), confidence (float), and language_detected (str | None).
- An abstract `TTSProvider` ABC with async method `synthesize(request: VoiceSynthesisRequest) -> VoiceSynthesisResult` and a classmethod `validate_identifier(provider_id: str, model_id: str) -> bool`.
- An abstract `STTProvider` ABC with async method `transcribe(request: VoiceTranscriptionRequest) -> VoiceTranscriptionResult` and a classmethod `validate_identifier(provider_id: str, model_id: str) -> bool`.
- A `get_voice_providers() -> dict[str, type[TTSProvider|STTProvider]]` registry function (initially empty dict literal).

Voice provider/model identifiers must follow the exact same validation discipline as the LLM providers in chatbot/providers/. Provider IDs use the format `provider_name` (lowercase, no slashes). Model IDs for OpenRouter-hosted voice models use `openrouter/voice/vendor/model`.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- chatbot/providers/ (any existing provider base classes) for the Provider interface pattern, identifier validation, and registry conventions
- backends/openrouter_models.py for model identifier format conventions
- chatbot/ (any existing package __init__.py files) for export patterns

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed paths. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed files modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.
acceptance_criteria: chatbot/voice/__init__.py exists and exports TTSProvider, STTProvider, and get_voice_providers
chatbot/voice/base.py exists and defines VoiceSynthesisRequest, VoiceSynthesisResult, VoiceTranscriptionRequest, VoiceTranscriptionResult
chatbot/voice/base.py defines abstract TTSProvider ABC with synthesize() and validate_identifier()
chatbot/voice/base.py defines abstract STTProvider ABC with transcribe() and validate_identifier()
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify any file outside chatbot/voice/__init__.py and chatbot/voice/base.py
change the Abracapocus runtime, orchestrator, or backends
wire concrete TTS/STT implementations or API clients

allowed: use abc.ABC for abstract base classes
add a registry dict for provider discovery
